tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Under the --page gradient in both themes; also the text color on ink-filled surfaces.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands (use at about 72% opacity so the space backdrop shows through) and inline code or cost chips.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, nav pills and inputs. Slightly translucent in Deep Space: pair with backdrop-filter: blur(8px).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-alt and card. 16.0:1 in both Daybreak and Deep Space on bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, metadata, kicker labels. At least 5.8:1 on every ground in both modes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dashed grids, inactive borders, progress-bar tracks. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 2px border on interactive controls (buttons, chips, toggles, inputs, game boards). At least 3:1 against every ground (WCAG 1.4.11). Cool slate gray in Deep Space.

tokens.name: ledge
tokens.usage: The solid 3 to 5px drop under raised controls (box-shadow 0 3px 0). Decorative. A dark slate in Deep Space. Pressing a control collapses it to 1px.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Signature accent and the lead hue, as a FILL: primary buttons, Bug Hunt, highlights, tags. Always carries on-accent text. For coral text, icons or chart marks use coral-strong.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Success and Bolt, the supporting hue, as a FILL with on-accent text. For text, icons or marks use teal-strong.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Amber, for highlights only: highlighter, hover and selected states, the current journey level, as a FILL. Always carries on-accent text. For text use sun-strong.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Information and Brain Lab, as a FILL with on-accent text. Same values as teal (the palette has three hues); kept as its own name so pages can say what a color means. For text, links, icons or marks use sky-strong.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Games and play, as a FILL with on-accent text. Same values as coral (the palette has three hues); kept as its own name so pages can say what a color means. For text use plum-strong.

tokens.name: coral-strong
tokens.usage: Coral for text, links, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: teal-strong
tokens.usage: Teal for text, success labels, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: sun-strong
tokens.usage: Amber for text and icons (warnings, highlights). At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: sky-strong
tokens.usage: Deep teal for links, text, focus rings, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: plum-strong
tokens.usage: Plum (same values as coral-strong) for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral, teal, sun, sky or plum fills. At least 6.2:1 on every fill in both modes. Use this, not white: white on coral is 2.8:1 and fails.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px outline, 3px offset. Alias of sky-strong, at least 3:1 against every ground.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets (dialog::backdrop). Dims the page so the panel reads as the only thing to act on.

tokens.name: media-black
tokens.usage: Fixed black behind video and other media (letterboxing, the player frame). The same in both schemes.

tokens.name: media-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed white for captions and controls drawn on media-black. 21:1 on media-black. Never on page grounds.

tokens.name: cat-red
tokens.usage: Category colour red, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-red-strong.

tokens.name: cat-orange
tokens.usage: Category colour orange, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-orange-strong.

tokens.name: cat-yellow
tokens.usage: Category colour yellow, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-yellow-strong.

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: Category colour green, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-green-strong.

tokens.name: cat-blue
tokens.usage: Category colour blue, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-blue-strong.

tokens.name: cat-purple
tokens.usage: Category colour purple, as a FILL (belts, category tiles, legend keys, chart areas). Always carries on-accent text (at least 6.4:1). One of six distinct hues; for text or marks use cat-purple-strong.

tokens.name: cat-red-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour red for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: cat-orange-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour orange for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: cat-yellow-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour yellow for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: cat-green-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour green for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: cat-blue-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour blue for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: cat-purple-strong
tokens.usage: Category colour purple for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: bolt-body
tokens.usage: Bolt the mascot: body, arms and the logo's head. Fixed in both schemes.

tokens.name: bolt-screen
tokens.usage: Bolt: the pale mint face screen. Fixed.

tokens.name: bolt-accent
tokens.usage: Bolt: antenna ball, cheeks and grin. Fixed.

tokens.name: bolt-belly
tokens.usage: Bolt: chest plate and antenna tip. Fixed.

tokens.name: bolt-eye
tokens.usage: Bolt: eye whites and buttons. Fixed white, so Bolt looks the same on the dark scheme (card is translucent dark there and will not do).

tokens.name: bolt-line
tokens.usage: Bolt: outlines and pupils, navy in both schemes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name only. clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.4rem). Swap the family to display-space in Deep Space.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles below the hero size: app and report heroes, the h1 of any page that is not the home page. clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 3.3rem).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles and scoreboards.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I teach computers how to listen, think, and help people.
styles.usage: Hero and section intros, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick your building blocks, stay within budget, then launch.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header nav links and app tabs (the shared header).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, toggles, nav links (nav at 15px/600).

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Compact controls: small buttons, switches, the Music pill, segmented controls.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above stats and lists, in ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Agent thoughts, code backdrops, costs, demo disclaimers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge offsets.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label in pills, between stacked small labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inline buttons and icon plus label.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Header and toolbar gaps; padding inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside dense grids (cards in the Design Lab, stat tiles).

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside stat tiles and list rows; gap in dense card grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-4-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; side padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (20 to 22px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between section header and content; two-column layout gap.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width (.wrap).

tokens.name: radius-2xs
tokens.usage: Progress bar fills, equalizer bars, tiny marks.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, focus ring corners, small swatches and keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Program blocks, icon tiles' inner shapes, small badges, level buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Option cards, stats, the program tray, speech bubbles (18px).

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles (md-bubble).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (the --radius token on the site).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero call-out panels like Say hi.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, nav pills, toggles.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons, avatars, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. A soft lift in both modes.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Raised controls (buttons, chips, game boards use 5px). Hover: 5px and translateY(-2px). Active: 1px and translateY(2px).

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-hover
tokens.usage: Raised control on hover, with translateY(-2px).

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-press
tokens.usage: Raised control while pressed, with translateY(2px).

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, toasts and popovers: anything floating above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: A soft amber ring around the current or selected item (the current level, a hinted key). Decorative: never the only sign of state.

tokens.name: bolt-glow
tokens.usage: filter for Bolt and space illustrations: none in Daybreak, a faint coral glow in Deep Space.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the shared site header row.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons, the Explore button, the theme button.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: The same controls on phones (600px and narrower).

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content above the space backdrop.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky site header.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and panels that open from the header (the music panel).

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Non-modal overlays and sheets that are not a <dialog>.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack, above overlays.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link, above everything.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press and lift of raised controls.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Switches, fades, small reveals.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The theme button spin, dialogs and toasts entering.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Springy UI: switch knobs, the theme button, level nodes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things entering: dialogs, toasts, sections fading up.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: The heading family: Fredoka in Daybreak, Space Grotesk in Deep Space. Every heading uses font-family: var(--display).

tokens.name: tracking-heading
tokens.usage: Letter spacing of headings: tighter in Deep Space, where Space Grotesk runs wide.

tokens.name: primary-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-border
tokens.usage: Border of the primary button: navy in Daybreak, none in Deep Space.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter for cards and controls, so the starfield shows through in Deep Space.

tokens.name: fo
tokens.usage: Opacity of space backdrop objects (floaters).

tokens.name: floater-opacity
tokens.usage: Space backdrop objects in Daybreak; Deep Space uses 0.45. The values pages use are the themed --fo token (theme group); this entry documents the Daybreak default.
